$comment: The symbol universe served by the site. Every symbol is fetched from Alpha Vantage, whose TIME_SERIES_MONTHLY_ADJUSTED is free and returns adjusted closes directly. Alpha Vantage does not carry Borsa Italiana, so Milan-listed symbols are mapped to their XETRA, Frankfurt or Amsterdam listing in the same currency. Add a symbol here, run scripts/map-alphavantage.mjs to resolve non-US ids, then run scripts/fetch-market-data.mjs.
